spread: nfl_season_games.market_spread_line (positive = home favoured), used only when market_captured_at is before kickoff
line: latest prop_odds_history capture before kickoff; among the listed books with a line and both prices, the highest line, ties to the best under price; a player quoted by one listed book is skipped

settlement.source: nflverse stats_player_week, regular season; the player's team is the stat row's team

verdict.when: the first grade run after every cohort game through week 18 is graded
